Demilitarized Zone.name: Demilitarized Zone
Demilitarized Zone.description: This planet gains a demilitarized zone. Units on this planet cannot be declared as defenders.

Freelancers.name: Freelancers
Freelancers.description: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on this planet.

Gamma Wormhole.name: Gamma Wormhole
Gamma Wormhole.description: Place a gamma wormhole token in this system.

Ion Storm.name: Ion Storm
Ion Storm.description: Place the ion storm token in this or an adjacent system. Ships cannot use SUSTAIN DAMAGE in this system.

Mirage.name: Mirage
Mirage.description: Place the Mirage token in this system as a planet with 1/2 and the cultural trait.

Core Mine.name: Core Mine
Core Mine.description: Gain 1 trade good for each planet you control that has an industrial trait.

Functioning Base.name: Functioning Base
Functioning Base.description: Gain 1 commodity and place 1 infantry on this planet.

Warfare Research Facility.name: Warfare Research Facility
Warfare Research Facility.description: Gain 1 warfare technology that you meet the prerequisites for.

Lazax Survivors.name: Lazax Survivors
Lazax Survivors.description: Place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on this planet.

Mining World.name: Mining World
Mining World.description: This planet's resource value is increased by 2.

Rich World.name: Rich World
Rich World.description: This planet's resource value is increased by 1.

Paradise World.name: Paradise World
Paradise World.description: This planet's influence value is increased by 2.

Dyson Sphere.name: Dyson Sphere
Dyson Sphere.description: Gain 2 trade goods and draw 1 action card.

Expedition.name: Expedition
Expedition.description: Draw 1 action card and gain 1 trade good.

Stellar Converter.name: Stellar Converter
Stellar Converter.description: Destroy 1 non-fighter ship in an adjacent system.

Biotic Research Facility.name: Biotic Research Facility
Biotic Research Facility.description: Gain 1 biotic technology that you meet the prerequisites for.

Cybernetic Research Facility.name: Cybernetic Research Facility
Cybernetic Research Facility.description: Gain 1 cybernetic technology that you meet the prerequisites for.

Propulsion Research Facility.name: Propulsion Research Facility
Propulsion Research Facility.description: Gain 1 propulsion technology that you meet the prerequisites for.
